assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis codes I48.91 and I48.0 are associated with the patient's condition.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture arrhythmic episodes and guide further management.
CPT code 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The payer's clinical indication note confirms that mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for the stated purpose.
The claim was denied with denial code CO-197.
Denial code CO-197 indicates that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered.
